description: This file defines interfaces for Orleans grains related to stream reliability testing, including generic and non-generic versions, with methods for managing consumers, producers, and stream interactions.

classes.name: IStreamReliabilityTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for stream reliability testing grain with methods for managing consumers, producers, and stream interactions, with optional generics based on compilation symbol.

classes.name: IStreamUnsubscribeTestGrain
classes.description: Interface for grains that handle stream subscription and unsubscription.

methods.name: GetReceivedCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of received items.

methods.name: GetErrorsCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of errors encountered.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping to the grain.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Adds a consumer to a stream, generic and non-generic variants.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer from a stream, generic and non-generic variants.

methods.name: BecomeProducer
methods.description: Sets the grain as a producer for a given stream.

methods.name: RemoveProducer
methods.description: Removes the grain as a producer from a stream.

methods.name: ClearGrain
methods.description: Clears internal state of the grain.

methods.name: IsConsumer
methods.description: Checks if the grain is a consumer.

methods.name: IsProducer
methods.description: Checks if the grain is a producer.

methods.name: GetConsumerHandlesCount
methods.description: Gets the number of consumer handles.

methods.name: GetConsumerObserversCount
methods.description: Gets the number of consumer observers.

methods.name: SendItem
methods.description: Sends an item to the stream, generic and non-generic variants.

methods.name: GetLocation
methods.description: Gets the location of the grain.

methods.name: Subscribe
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a stream.
